restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r1-prefix-v1 only (one partial round plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

Success probability 1 means: one deterministic procedure (centres c_i = i tried in the order i = 1, 2, 3, ... until the first collision) was executed once from the start on the fixed target and stopped with a collision after 1 trials; the time is the executed operation count of that run with every trial charged, failed ones included, and the memory its executed peak. It is not a probability over centres; no start was selected beforehand.

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 describe the executed program of proof.md section 9 under the stated rules: 1 per field operation, 1 per element load or store, 1/2 per butterfly and per element of an unrolled loop for loop and address work, 1 per other executed index or control operation, 237 per reduced permutation evaluation, and a register file of 18 words of 256 bits per transform block (16 data words plus two working words: the twiddle operand and the butterfly temporary) as the only register assumption.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the executed run of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 39062 for the powering, N = 98304 and N' = 49152 in its transforms, 98304 evaluations of the line).
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The time is the executed total of one run of the shipped source, with every trial charged; no bound, estimate or other run enters it.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; the source is part of the proof text and was not run by the organizer. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.
